site.name: WhatsApp Widget
site.description: Add a floating widget to open WhatsApp

hero.title: WhatsApp Widget
hero.lede: Add a floating widget to open WhatsApp

features.title: One script, no build step
features.text: Add one snippet at the end of the page. It loads the widget and its styles from the CDN.

features.title: Several people, one button
features.text: Each agent has a name, a phone number, a label for the hours and a call to action. A click opens the chat in WhatsApp, with a first message if you set one.

features.title: Only the agents who are available
features.text: A schedule for each day of the week. An agent outside its hours is not shown, and with nobody available the widget is not drawn.

features.title: Try it before you paste it
features.text: Set the texts and the agents, see the widget working, and copy the code for your page.
